description: This file declares utility functions related to WAN Manager bus operations, such as retrieving parameter values and instance numbers, for a broadband or network management system.

methods.name: GetParamValueUlong
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value as an unsigned long given its name.

methods.name: GetParamValueString
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value as a string given its name.

methods.name: GetParamValueBool
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter's boolean value given its name.

methods.name: GetInstanceNumberByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the instance number associated with an object name and index.
